concerns.text: Task T008b attempts to download 'official release logs' from a HuggingFace dataset key 'stack-exchange/stackoverflow-survey' (split 'release_logs') which is not defined in the Spec Assumptions or Plan. The Spec Assumptions state logs are 'publicly available' but do not provide a canonical URL or dataset key. T008b's fallback to an empty file means SC-003 (alignment of seasonal peaks) cannot be measured against a reference calendar, leaving the Success Criterion untestable.

Task T039 (External Metrics Fetch) references GitHub Search API base URL `)` and NPM Search API base URL `)` which are empty/invalid placeholders. The Spec FR-007 requires fetching these metrics, but the task description lacks the actual canonical URLs required to implement the fetch logic, making the task unexecutable as written.

Task T012 (Download PostsTags) references the canonical URL `)` which is empty/invalid. The Spec FR-001 mandates downloading from a specific canonical URL. Without the actual URL in the task description, the implementer cannot verify the source or implement the 'Fail Loudly' policy correctly.

Task T054 (Data Source Fallback Verification) is marked as unchecked `[ ]` in the Revision Tasks section, while all other tasks are marked `[X]`. This indicates the task is not yet implemented or accepted, leaving the 'Fail Loudly' policy for the primary data source unverified in the task list.
